command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP 1: create opsadmin user if missing ==="
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
  echo "opsadmin created"
else
  echo "opsadmin already exists"
fi

echo "=== STEP 2: create a throwaway test user to prove denial ==="
if ! getent passwd cronprobe >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash cronprobe
fi

echo "=== STEP 3: write /etc/cron.allow with only root and opsadmin ==="
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cron.allow
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.allow
cat /etc/cron.allow

echo "=== STEP 4: remove cron.deny if present (allow list takes precedence, avoid ambiguity) ==="
sudo -n rm -f /etc/cron.deny
ls -la /etc/cron.allow /etc/cron.deny 2>&1 || true

echo "=== STEP 5: verify enforcement ==="
echo "--- root ---"
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u root -' && echo "root: ALLOWED (expected)"
echo "--- opsadmin ---"
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u opsadmin -' && echo "opsadmin: ALLOWED (expected)"
echo "--- cronprobe (should be denied) ---"
set +e
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u cronprobe -' 2>/tmp/cronprobe_err.txt
rc=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/cronprobe_err.txt
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "cronprobe: DENIED (expected)"
else
  echo "cronprobe: ALLOWED (UNEXPECTED FAILURE)"
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== STEP 6: listing crontabs to confirm root/opsadmin entries installed ==="
sudo -n crontab -u root -l
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l

echo "=== STEP 7: cleanup test crontabs (remove the probe test entries, keep allow config) ==="
sudo -n crontab -u root -r
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -r
sudo -n userdel -r cronprobe 2>&1 || true
echo "cleanup done"
